item.description: O’ Romeo had another fall in business on its 2nd Friday, with collections going below Rs. 2 crore nett. The drop from Thursday was 25-30 per cent. Films these days tend to stay flat on Fridays, especially those catering to bigger centres. However, since O’ Romeo had a partial holiday on Thursday and a BOGO offer was in effect on weekdays, which kept the business elevated.
